WITH
-- 1) FACTURA muy cara para su gremio (>200% mediana proyectos completados)
invoice_high AS (
  INSERT INTO anomalies_detected (project_id, entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type, severity, description, baseline_value, observed_value, deviation_pct, reference_set)
  SELECT i.project_id, 'invoice', i.id, 'invoice_above_median_for_trade', 'high',
         'Factura ' || i.total_amount || 'eur del gremio ' || COALESCE(i.trade_type, 'sin gremio') || ' supera 2x la mediana historica',
         med.median_amount, i.total_amount,
         round(((i.total_amount - med.median_amount) / NULLIF(med.median_amount, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2),
         'Mediana ' || med.n || ' facturas mismo trade_type'
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_amount) AS median_amount, count(*) AS n
        FROM invoices i2
       WHERE i2.trade_type = i.trade_type
         AND i2.id != i.id
         AND i2.total_amount IS NOT NULL
    ) med ON med.n >= 5
   WHERE i.total_amount IS NOT NULL
     AND i.total_amount > med.median_amount * 2
     AND i.created_at > now() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
-- 2) FACTURA con OCR baja confianza
invoice_low_conf AS (
  INSERT INTO anomalies_detected (project_id, entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type, severity, description, reference_set)
  SELECT i.project_id, 'invoice', i.id, 'invoice_low_ocr_confidence', 'low',
         'OCR con confianza baja en factura ' || COALESCE(i.invoice_number, 'sin numero') || ' (' || COALESCE(i.supplier_name, '?') || ')',
         'OCR confidence field'
    FROM invoices i
   WHERE i.ocr_confidence = 'low'
     AND i.status = 'pending_review'
     AND i.created_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
-- 3) FACTURA con tipo IVA inusual (no 21/10/4)
invoice_weird_vat AS (
  INSERT INTO anomalies_detected (project_id, entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type, severity, description, observed_value, reference_set)
  SELECT i.project_id, 'invoice', i.id, 'invoice_unusual_vat_rate', 'medium',
         'Tipo IVA inusual ' || i.vat_rate || '% en factura de ' || COALESCE(i.supplier_name, '?'),
         i.vat_rate,
         'IVA estandar Espana: 21/10/4'
    FROM invoices i
   WHERE i.vat_rate IS NOT NULL
     AND i.vat_rate NOT IN (21, 10, 4, 0)
     AND i.created_at > now() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
-- 4) PROYECTO con desviacion economica critica (>40% sobre estimado)
project_overrun AS (
  INSERT INTO anomalies_detected (project_id, entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type, severity, description, baseline_value, observed_value, deviation_pct)
  SELECT p.id, 'project', p.id, 'budget_overrun_critical', 'critical',
         'Proyecto facturado supera estimado en >40%',
         ce.total_estimated,
         pf.total_facturado,
         round(((pf.total_facturado - ce.total_estimated) / NULLIF(ce.total_estimated, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2)
    FROM projects p
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT total_estimated FROM cost_estimates WHERE project_id = p.id ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) ce ON true
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(sum(total_amount), 0) AS total_facturado FROM invoices WHERE project_id = p.id) pf ON true
   WHERE p.current_phase NOT IN ('completed','archived')
     AND ce.total_estimated > 0
     AND pf.total_facturado > ce.total_estimated * 1.40
  ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
-- 5) AFTERCARE: tiempo abierta excesivo para severity
aftercare_stale AS (
  INSERT INTO anomalies_detected (project_id, entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type, severity, description, observed_value)
  SELECT ai.project_id, 'aftercare_incident', ai.id, 'aftercare_open_too_long', 'high',
         'Incidencia ' || ai.severity || ' lleva ' || round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ai.reported_at))/86400)::numeric) || ' dias abierta',
         round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ai.reported_at))/86400)::numeric)
    FROM aftercare_incidents ai
   WHERE ai.status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed')
     AND (
       (ai.severity = 'urgent' AND ai.reported_at < now() - INTERVAL '3 days') OR
       (ai.severity = 'high'   AND ai.reported_at < now() - INTERVAL '14 days') OR
       (ai.severity = 'medium' AND ai.reported_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days')
     )
  ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
-- 6) PERMITS muy retrasados (>200% del expected_response_days)
permit_severely_overdue AS (
  INSERT INTO anomalies_detected (project_id, entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type, severity, description, baseline_value, observed_value, deviation_pct)
  SELECT pa.project_id, 'permit_application', pa.id, 'permit_severely_overdue', 'high',
         'Expediente ' || COALESCE(pa.expediente_id, '?') || ' lleva mas del doble de lo esperado',
         pa.expected_response_days,
         round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - pa.submitted_at))/86400)::numeric),
         round((((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - pa.submitted_at))/86400) - pa.expected_response_days) / pa.expected_response_days * 100)::numeric, 2)
    FROM permit_applications pa
   WHERE pa.status NOT IN ('approved','rejected','withdrawn','expired')
     AND pa.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
     AND pa.expected_response_days IS NOT NULL
     AND pa.submitted_at + (pa.expected_response_days * 2 || ' days')::interval < now()
  ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
-- 7) SITE REPORT con regresion de progreso (progress_pct cae entre reports)
site_regression AS (
  INSERT INTO anomalies_detected (project_id, entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type, severity, description, baseline_value, observed_value, deviation_pct)
  SELECT sr.project_id, 'site_report', sr.id, 'progress_regression', 'medium',
         'Progress_pct cayo en site_report respecto al anterior',
         prev.progress_pct,
         sr.progress_pct,
         round(((sr.progress_pct - prev.progress_pct))::numeric, 2)
    FROM site_reports sr
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT progress_pct, reported_at FROM site_reports sr2
       WHERE sr2.project_id = sr.project_id
         AND sr2.reported_at < sr.reported_at
         AND sr2.progress_pct IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY sr2.reported_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) prev ON true
   WHERE sr.progress_pct IS NOT NULL
     AND sr.progress_pct < prev.progress_pct - 5
     AND sr.created_at > now() - INTERVAL '14 days'
  ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
-- 8) TRADE_QUOTES sin respuesta despues de 14d
quote_no_reply AS (
  INSERT INTO anomalies_detected (project_id, entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type, severity, description, observed_value)
  SELECT tq.project_id, 'trade_quote', tq.id, 'quote_no_reply_14d', 'low',
         COALESCE(tq.supplier_name, 'gremio') || ' lleva sin responder >14 dias',
         round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - tq.request_sent_at))/86400)::numeric)
    FROM trade_quotes tq
   WHERE tq.status = 'requested'
     AND tq.request_sent_at IS NOT NULL
     AND tq.request_sent_at < now() - INTERVAL '14 days'
  ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, anomaly_type) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'invoice_high',           (SELECT count(*) FROM invoice_high),
  'invoice_low_conf',       (SELECT count(*) FROM invoice_low_conf),
  'invoice_weird_vat',      (SELECT count(*) FROM invoice_weird_vat),
  'project_overrun',        (SELECT count(*) FROM project_overrun),
  'aftercare_stale',        (SELECT count(*) FROM aftercare_stale),
  'permit_overdue',         (SELECT count(*) FROM permit_severely_overdue),
  'site_regression',        (SELECT count(*) FROM site_regression),
  'quote_no_reply',         (SELECT count(*) FROM quote_no_reply),
  'total_new',              (SELECT count(*) FROM anomalies_detected WHERE status='new' AND alert_sent=false)
) AS report;

SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY
  CASE t.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
  t.detected_at DESC
) AS rows
FROM (
  SELECT a.id, a.entity_type, a.anomaly_type, a.severity, a.description,
         a.baseline_value, a.observed_value, a.deviation_pct, a.reference_set,
         a.detected_at,
         p.name AS project_name
    FROM anomalies_detected a
    LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = a.project_id
   WHERE a.status = 'new' AND a.alert_sent = false
) t;

UPDATE anomalies_detected SET alert_sent = true WHERE alert_sent = false AND status = 'new';
SELECT count(*) AS marked FROM anomalies_detected WHERE alert_sent = true;
SELECT value FROM system_config WHERE key = 'architect_email'
